d: A meeting between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Mozambique's President Daniel Chapo has gone viral after the 6 foot 8 inches tall Chapo was seen 'towering' over a 5 foot 7 inches tall Putin. The meeting took place on the sidelines of the ongoing third Russia-Africa summit. While Putin and Chapo spoke about bilateral ties, energy cooperation and trade, it was their handshake photo that took social media by storm.
